agendas.name: Genestealer's Kiss
agendas.description: Each time a PATRIARCH or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS unit destroys an enemy unit, it gains 1XP. If on the Path of Ascension and total 3+ XP gained from this agenda, add 1 to your next Setback roll.

agendas.name: Silence Detractor
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects one of their CHARACTERs as the Detractor. If destroyed by a GSC unit with SANCTUS, LOCUS, KELERMORPH, or JACKAL ALPHUS keyword, the Detractor is silenced: subtract 1 from your next Setback roll.

agendas.name: Telepathic Domination
agendas.description: During Shooting phase, task an eligible PSYKER unit (no shoot/charge). At end of turn, if within 18" of opponent's battlefield edge: 1XP. If total 2+ XP gained, add +1 to your next Setback roll.

agendas.name: Prepared for the Ordeal
agendas.description: During Shooting phase, task a BATTLELINE unit in a terrain feature not already Prepared (no shoot/charge). Next turn, if still in that terrain: 2XP, feature becomes Prepared. If 3+ features Prepared, you are Prepared for the Ordeal (+2 starting CP in the Great Ordeal).

agendas.name: Topple the False Temple
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects a Ruins terrain feature as the false temple. During Shooting phase, task a BATTLELINE or REDUCTUS SABOTEUR unit in the temple (no shoot/charge). Next Command phase, if still in the temple: topple it (true line of sight applies), unit gains 4XP.
